segments.he: מַתְנִי' הָעוֹלָה קׇדְשֵׁי קָדָשִׁים, שְׁחִיטָתָהּ בַּצָּפוֹן, וְקִיבּוּל דָּמָהּ בִּכְלֵי שָׁרֵת בַּצָּפוֹן, וְדָמָהּ טָעוּן שְׁתֵּי מַתָּנוֹת שֶׁהֵן אַרְבַּע, וּטְעוּנָה הֶפְשֵׁט וְנִיתּוּחַ, וְכָלִיל לָאִשִּׁים.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «The burnt offering» is «an offering of the most sacred order. Its slaughter» is «in the north» of the Temple courtyard «and the collection of its blood in a service vessel» is «in the north, and its blood requires two placements that are four, and» it «requires flaying» of its carcass «and the cutting» of the sacrificial animal into pieces, «and» it is consumed «in its entirety,» with the exception of its hide, «by the fire» of the altar.

positions.claim: the burnt offering is most sacred, slaughtered in the north, two placements that are four, flayed, cut, wholly burned
